answer:
Right now, you can't tell yet. Nothing has been measured: there's no evaluation on record, and the first real answer hasn't been read.

Quality is measured by running your golden dataset (`eval/golden`) as an evaluation. A mock evaluation is free but only proves the wiring. A real evaluation runs the cases against the real models and scores the answers, giving you a pass rate, the cost, and the failing cases.

Two things are missing before a real score means much. `EVAL_DESIGN.md` is absent, so "good" isn't defined yet. And the golden cases still need your review.

The pass threshold is yours to set. What pass rate would you accept before this workflow goes anywhere near production?
